name: maintaining codex situational knowledge
from: The Codex actuation office holding only its own prior turns assumptions about the Leaders move, the repositorys state, and which providers are offering capability -- stale the instant any of the three changes underneath it.
to: A content-addressed LeaderMoveK, RepositoryEvidenceK, and ProviderMarketK the office can cite instead of re-deriving from memory -- three monitor-stage skills kept current rather than trusted from the last time they were run.
cost: The offices own attention spent re-observing the Leaders expression, the repositorys evidence, and the provider market on every cycle, rather than assuming yesterdays read still holds.
otherwise: The office plans and executes against a picture of the Leaders move, the repository, or the market that has already drifted, and the drift is discovered only when a downstream skill fails against evidence it should have consumed fresh.
